Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Official 'Meet Natla' Overview
recentItems.description: Take a look at the 'Meet Natla' Overview for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, the upcoming action-adventure remake of the original Tomb Raider developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog. Players will hear from Adrienne Wilkinson on her portrayal of Jacqueline Natla, a key role in pushing Lara Croft to go the distance. Explore more of Jacqueline Natla in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, launching on February 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons - First Look at Gameplay
recentItems.description:
Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons is a single-player, third-person, open-world action-adventure game from developer Invoke Studios, and its new gameplay reveal gives us an extended look at how forbidden magic lets players bend the rules, manipulate the world, and overcome challenges in creative ways across exploration and combat.

Presented by Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons

recentItems.title: Crimson Moon - Official Beginners Gameplay Guide Trailer
recentItems.description: Don't miss the Beginners Gameplay Guide Trailer for Crimson Moon, an upcoming third-person dark fantasy action RPG developed by ProbablyMonsters. Players get an overview of the game's core fundamentals, including combat, progression, and more. Crimson Moon is launching on September 1 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
